acceptance.given: the same child with a child of its own
acceptance.when: it reads its own and its child's KERN_PROCARGS2 and pidinfo

acceptance.given: the same policy with HardDenyClass::ProcessAccess waived
acceptance.when: the child reads the other process's KERN_PROCARGS2

requirements.statement: On Linux T1 and T2 a policy whose file rule, raw Landlock rule or glob reaches /proc other than /proc/self and /proc/thread-self (literally, through an ancestor such as /, or through a symbolic link resolved at cage creation), or a grant whose resolved path does at spawn, MUST be refused naming proc-other-processes unless the caller accepts it by name; an accepted rule MUST be listed in the plan and an accepted grant in the run's receipt, which is then not enforced as written; other processes' environ MUST stay unreadable.

acceptance.given: T1 or T2 and a rule on /proc
acceptance.when: the cage is made without the approximation

acceptance.then: environ is refused, cmdline is readable (the residual), its own environ is readable, and the plan lists the approximation
acceptance.when: the child reads another process's environ and cmdline and its own environ

acceptance.given: a rule on a symbolic link to /proc
acceptance.then: it is refused naming the construct, then made with the approximation in the plan
acceptance.when: the cage is made without, then with the approximation

acceptance.given: a grant bound at spawn to a symbolic link to /proc
acceptance.then: the spawn is refused naming the construct, then the receipt lists the approximation and enforced_as_written is false
acceptance.when: the run is spawned without, then with the approximation
